scripts.dev:app: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run build:electron && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.build:electron: esbuild electron/main.ts electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --external:jsdom --external:undici --outdir=dist-electron && esbuild electron/po-page.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist-electron/po-page.js && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('electron/po.html','dist-electron/po.html')"
scripts.test: esbuild src/lib/account-validators.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/account-validators.mjs && esbuild src/lib/config.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/config.mjs && esbuild electron/sync-merge.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/sync-merge.mjs && esbuild electron/audio-format.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/audio-format.mjs && esbuild electron/backup-transfer.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/backup-transfer.mjs && esbuild electron/local-paths.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/local-paths.mjs && esbuild src/lib/deletion-sync.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/deletion-sync.mjs && esbuild src/lib/download-reconcile.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/download-reconcile.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:electron && vite build
